responsibility: Builds LRA pseudo live ranges and related per-pseudo liveness data used by assignment, coalescing, and spill-slot placement. It scans RTL backward over program points, computes live ranges, hard-register conflicts, preferred hard-register hints, copies, call/setjmp crossing information, point frequencies, and updated REG_DEAD/REG_UNUSED notes, and can rerun global live propagation when local transformations change border liveness. This file supplies the core liveness model for iterative LRA decisions.
